description: This file defines controller functions for handling node-related API endpoints in an Express.js application, including fetching nodes, getting node icons, and executing custom functions.

methods.name: getAllNodes
methods.description: Fetches all nodes via nodesService and returns the response as JSON.

methods.name: getNodeByName
methods.description: Fetches a node by name, throws error if name parameter is missing.

methods.name: getNodesByCategory
methods.description: Fetches nodes for a specific category, unescapes category name.

methods.name: getSingleNodeIcon
methods.description: Retrieves and sends the icon file for a specific node.

methods.name: getSingleNodeAsyncOptions
methods.description: Fetches async options for a node, requires request body and name parameter.

methods.name: executeCustomFunction
methods.description: Executes a custom function with provided request body, user organization and workspace IDs.
